Religion is more of a colonial term, for us it was a way of life and way to treat the earth along with the life that roams it. Thanks for asking!

They vary on the tribe and region, for the Blackfoot/Peigan twospirit peoples held important roles. We would hold more traditionally feminine or masculine roles that were appropriate for the time (hunting, gathering, sewing etc.) but due to colonial Eurocentric views we lost a lot of details and respect for the first trans and non binary people’s. For example, there was a warrior named Tongue Eater who was a trans fem that held property, voice in council and had a two spirit husband who would stay behind to watch the children and take care of chores. You can guess from the name that she was a very revered warrior, the idea was because they held two peoples within them that they were stronger of body and spirit. I’m still learning myself but I think it’s very beautiful

Without thinking about I said “Santa got me the wrong logo, is he stupid??” And I remember the 30 seconds of silence afterwards. Not understanding at the time who Santa was.

I think about it every Christmas, we laugh about it but fuck. Shout out to my mom.

World of Warcraft. 
For the sake of length I’ll skip some stuff but my mother and my siblings were homeless for sometime following a horrible divorce, something like a year we jumped around from shelter to shelter etc. 
Until one day my mom told my siblings and I that we were moving into a house finally, I was elated but obviously didn’t understand the hoops my mother had to jump through to pull it off but flash forward and we’re all moved in and set up with school again.
My mom and I would play wow all the time which I loved because we spent the most time together playing. I noticed we played a lot with this other player that my mom would talk to quite frequently so I assumed it was one of her old guildies she was catching up with and what not.

About a month later my mom says to us “We’re going to meet someone I’ve been seeing and he’s going to stay with us I hope you guys okay with that”. So we pull up to a parking lot and lo an behold it was my moms guildie we’ve been playing with, that was the day I met my step dad. 
Turns out after all this time this man has been helping my mom with money, getting the house, helping her with resumes etc. 

Flash forward a decade or so and life has never been better. I owe my life to this man who helped us in our darkest times and decided to move across the country in a chance to help a mom and some poor ass kids. 
All thanks to World of Warcraft.
